name: dev.ciranda/kolo-docs
title: Kolo docs
description: Search and read the Kolo documentation in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Kolo documentation: guides, concepts, the API reference of every library, limits, security and the changelog. Returns the best matching sections, each with its page id, the section URL and a short excerpt. Read a whole page with fetch.

query.description: Words to look for, such as a library, a type or a task: "kolo-relay Config", "recovery phrase".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one page of the Kolo documentation as Markdown. id is a page id from search or list_pages, any URL of a page on docs.kolo.ciranda.dev (with or without .md) or its path, such as /libraries/kolo-id/ or /es/libraries/kolo-id/.

id.description: The page id, URL or path.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page of the Kolo documentation in one language, in reading order, with its id, title and description.
